name: Kurosu Moe
source:
A food writer specializing in Akihabara who explores the town through its food.
Originally a general-interest reporter, she became fascinated with Akihabara’s subculture about three years ago. She now introduces everything from long-established restaurants to the latest trendy cafes and unique eateries from her own perspective.
While her casual outfits are accessorized to match her style, her tough, tomboyish personality is reflected in her beloved, rough and ready jeep.

[spoiler]A journalist specializing in international crime. She has spent years investigating the 'Akiba Vanishing' case, and even after the police called off their investigation, she has continued pursuing the truth in hopes of solving the mystery. With no major breakthrough in sight, she sets out to investigate Shinjo after he suddenly announces AKIBA LOST, a game based on the case. Disguising herself as a gourmet writer, she infiltrates Shirosawa Games as one of the cast members.[/spoiler]

[From in-game profile]
